title: 1871 streets get wood-block paving, stone walks and steps
items: Clark, Lake, Washington, State and Madison read as worn pine wood blocks with wheel tracks and dung, not grey setts.
Stone-flag walks and kerbs stand before the fine fronts in the photographs; stone crosswalks cross the paved streets.
Some walks stand a step or two up, Chicago's raised grade, and lamps and hydrants stand on them.
